# PerchTV 0.1.10

The television no longer goes deaf when the connection is closed from the other end.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Fixed: when the pairing service closed the television's connection — for example when another connection took over — the television never noticed. It sat on "Waiting" and ignored the phone until the app was restarted. It now reconnects on its own.
- Fixed: a late message from an old connection could interfere with the new one. Old connections are now ignored.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing, casting, play/pause and stop, the skip keys (10 s back, 30 s forward, hold for 5 minutes a second), the waiting screen that moves and goes dark, and the update check on every start.
